meta.title: Aries 2027 — Vishnu ji drafts, Sakshi notes
meta.version: v2 script draft (after 2 reviews) (times are estimates until voices exist)
meta.cta: send to an Aries friend + comment ARIES for all dates (owner to confirm what the DM sends)
meta.text_rules: min 48 px, max 2 text items on screen, captions count
meta.source: Aries 2027 summary given by the owner, 23 Nov 2026 (Vedic: Saturn 12th then 1st, Jupiter 5th, Rahu 10th / Ketu 4th)

beats.line: Prabhu, Aries ka 2027 likhiye… jaldi! Inse sabar nahi hota.
beats.picture: Night cloud study. Vishnu ji on his cloud; a big glowing scroll 'ARIES 2027' floats beside him and a magic quill writes by itself. Sakshi floats in on a small cloud, diary open in the air, pen glowing by her hand, tapping her foot.
beats.camera: Opens mid-motion on the quill; quick pull back to the two-shot.
beats.card: Hook card from frame 0: 'ARIES 2027: SADE SATI MEIN BHI ACHHA?' + ram-horn icon

beats.line: Haan, Mesh wale pehle koodte hain… phir poochte hain, paani kitna gehra tha.
beats.picture: Vishnu ji sly grin, eyebrow up; cut-in gag: a cartoon ram jumps into a pond, splash. Sakshi giggles and writes.
beats.camera: Push in on Vishnu ji, cut-in on the ram gag.

beats.line: Pehle kadwi dawai: Shani dev ki Sade Sati.
beats.picture: Vishnu ji turns calm and serious; the scroll writes 'SADE SATI' in deep blue; a small respectful Shani symbol glows in the scroll corner (Shani dev not shown, no gaze).
beats.camera: Slow push in, light dims a touch.
beats.card: Card (label inside): 'SHANI SADE SATI · Vedic maanyata'

beats.line: Sade Sati?! Prabhu, mera pen kaanp raha hai!
beats.picture: Sakshi's eyes go wide, brows up; her floating pen shivers and scribbles a zig-zag. The comic fear is hers, never about Shani dev.

beats.line: Darr mat. Shani dev mehnat ka phal dete hain, aur Guru ji ki kripa saath hai.

caption_chunks.text: Shani dev mehnat ka phal dete hain,
aur Guru ji ki kripa saath hai.

beats.picture: Vishnu ji warm smile, open palm; a soft golden Jupiter glow rises over the scroll and the gloom clears. Sakshi exhales.
beats.camera: Gentle pull back, warm light returns.
beats.card: Card: 'SHANI = MEHNAT KA PHAL · GURU = KRIPA'

beats.line: Sehat: March-April aur August-October, dhyaan rakhna. July? Full power.
beats.picture: Diary page fills: HEALTH with two careful windows. July is said in the voice only, with a flexing-arm doodle.
beats.card: Card: 'HEALTH ⚠ 9 Mar–26 Apr · 24 Aug–8 Oct' + small 'Doctor ki salah zaroor lein'

beats.line: Naukri: kaam ka pressure. Aur office mein koi boss ke kaan bharega.

caption_chunks.text: Aur office mein koi boss ke kaan bharega.

beats.picture: Cut-in gag: a tiny cartoon office; a faceless colleague whispers into a boss's huge ear. Vishnu ji raises one brow knowingly.

beats.line: Naam bata dijiye, Prabhu… main diary mein note kar leti hun!

caption_chunks.text: main diary mein note kar leti hun!

beats.picture: Sakshi leans in, eyes narrowed, cunning grin, pen ready over a blank 'SUSPECTS' list.

beats.line: Naam nahi, taarikh lo. April-May aur September-October, naukri mein koi risk mat lena.

caption_chunks.text: naukri mein koi risk mat lena.

beats.picture: Vishnu ji laughs softly, shakes his head; 'SUSPECTS' on her page turns into 'DATES'.
beats.card: Card: 'JOB: NO RISKS 5 Apr–6 May · 21 Sep–21 Oct'

beats.line: Paisa? Average se behtar. Best time: March-April, aur June.
beats.picture: Gold coins drift up from the scroll; Sakshi's eyes light up (round eyes, not anime).
Sakshi sneakily writes 'FERRARI' big in her diary (a generic red car doodle, no logo), side-eye at him.
Vishnu ji lifts a finger; the chakra glows softly (no toy spin) and 'FERRARI' turns into 'FD'. Sakshi pouts.

beats.line: Pyaar? Guru ji ki drishti hai. Love life badhiya, shaadi ke yog bhi. Bas August-October, behas nahi.
beats.picture: Hearts float up; Sakshi claps and blushes; on 'behas nahi' a tiny storm cloud passes over a heart and clears.
beats.card: Card: 'LOVE ✓ · SHAADI YOG ✓ · careful 24 Aug–8 Oct · Vedic maanyata'

beats.line: Toh mummy ki daant bhi dil pe nahi lena?

caption_chunks.text: Toh mummy ki daant bhi dil pe nahi lena?

beats.picture: Sakshi, hopeful and cheeky, pen over 'FAMILY'.

beats.line: Mummy ki daant? Wo toh sar aankhon pe. Ghar ki mahilaon ka samman, yahi asli upay.
beats.picture: Vishnu ji amused, gentle head shake, palm on heart; a cut-in of a warm family home with diyas.
beats.card: Card: 'FAMILY: badon ki baat dil pe nahi · PROPERTY: sirf saaf deal'

beats.line: Upay: har Mangalwar Sundarkand, chaandi ki chain, aur netraheen vyakti ko samman se bhojan.

caption_chunks.text: aur netraheen vyakti ko samman se bhojan.

beats.picture: One card whose three rows fill in, each synced to the spoken word. Sakshi writes each, nodding.
beats.card: Card: 'UPAY (Vedic maanyata) 1 Sundarkand, Mangalwar · 2 Chaandi ki chain · 3 Netraheen ko bhojan seva'

beats.line: Gussa kam, mehnat zyada. Guru ji ka saath hai.
beats.picture: Vishnu ji serene blessing, closes the scroll with a glow; Sakshi closes her diary with a happy sigh.

beats.line: Apne Aries dost ko bhejo. Mahine-wise guide chahiye? Comment karo ARIES.
beats.picture: CTA. Sakshi alone (Vishnu ji not in this beat): diary floats up, the one wink of the reel, send arrow, then a comment-box graphic 'ARIES'.
Sakshi's diary shows 'ARIES 2027 ✓' with a ram doodle; Sakshi alone with her diary (no deity in the selling part). Card: 'Send to your Aries friend · Comment ARIES'. Loops to frame 0.
